text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-89234 — High latency and 5xx rate for tenant 'saffron-prod' in reserved pool 'rp-saffron-03'. p95 token latency spiked to ~2.7s, error rate 1.8% (baseline <0.1%). Alert links: <https://pagerduty.internal/incidents/PD-89234> <https://dashboards.internal/tenants/saffron-prod/overview>

pagerduty-bot: PD-89234 assigned to oncall_jess (primary). Auto-escalation window: 10m.

oncall_jess: Acked. I'm on it. Jumping into dashboards and logs now.

sre_paul: I can see backlog on the reserved pool nodes: queue depth ~420 (normal <50). KV cache miss rate up from 6% -> 47% in last 12m. Looks like large burst of long-context requests causing KV churn.

eng-runtime-arjun: Confirming. p50 token latency up from 140ms -> 480ms, p95 2700ms. GPUs at 88% mem, RX throttles starting on a subset of nodes. Suspect model variant routing combined with small cache TTL.

oncall_jess: Quick mitigation plan: 1) enable tenant soft-throttle to 60% of reserved throughput 2) route overflow to hosted fallback model 'redwood-sm-1' for burst capacity 3) increase KV cache TTL on rp-saffron-03 nodes to reduce thrash. Executing now.

eng-platform-maya: @oncall_jess runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-tenant-latency (step 2->4 for throttle + fallback). If fallback rate >30% notify CS.

oncall_jess: Running throttle api and routing change. Commands: ```bash
# throttle tenant to 60%
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/v1/tenant/throttle -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"saffron-prod","percent":60}'
# add routing fallback rule for burst to hosted pool
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/v1/routing/rules -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"saffron-prod","trigger":"queue_depth>100","route_to":"hosted:redwood-sm-1"}'
```

oncall_jess: Throttle API returned 200. Routing rule created (rule id r-78c9). Applying KV cache TTL change to rp nodes now.

sre_paul: Thanks. I'm seeing queue_length come down to ~120 and 5xx rates drop to 0.6%. Good sign. KV cache TTL bumped from 30s -> 300s on rp-saffron-03 via: ```sh
kubectl exec -n serving node-3 -- redis-cli config set maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
# TTL update pushed to runtime via config roll (version bump v23.9.1 -> v23.9.2)
```

eng-runtime-arjun: Noted one noisy consumer pattern: a client is sending long prompt sequences repeatedly (avg seq len 1k tokens). CS please check with customer if they started a new job. We should not rollback throttle until they confirm.

customer-success-amy: Pinged Saffron support alias. Customer thread: "Saffron SRE: we see intermittent slowness on batch rerank and are throttling retries. Not aware of new jobs." They asked for us to share timeline and current mitigation. I sent them the temporary throttle + fallback note.

pagerduty-bot: PD-89234 update: alert status -> acknowledged by oncall_jess at 2551234570. Auto-escalation canceled.

oncall_jess: Current status: throttle at 60%, ~18% of requests routed to fallback hosted model, queue depth stable ~90, p95 down to 560ms. Continuing to monitor 30m. If stable we'll de-escalate and document run.

eng-platform-maya: Can you capture the exact nodes impacted and attach logs to the incident for postmortem? Use incident template: https://redwood.internal/incidents/templates/dedicated-latency.json

oncall_jess: Attached logs snippet and node list to the PD incident. Nodes: rp-saffron-03-{n1,n2,n3,n4}. Sample log lines: ```json
{"ts":2551234521,"node":"n3","err":"kv_cache_miss","lat_ms":2740,"req_id":"req_0c7a"}
{"ts":2551234524,"node":"n1","err":"request_queue_timeout","lat_ms":3001,"req_id":"req_0c8b"}
```

sre_paul: Will take over monitoring for the night. I'll keep the throttle in place and check for config regressions that could cause low TTL. If customer confirms no new jobs by 01:00 UTC we'll gradually relax throttle to 80% then 100%.

eng-runtime-arjun: Logging note — we'll create an action item to add better sampling for long-context requests to surface noisy tenants earlier. Filing ticket: INF-4129.

customer-success-amy: Customer acknowledged mitigation and appreciated the quick patch. They asked for a post-incident note. I'll draft a summary once internal wrap-up done.

oncall_jess: Handoff: @sre_paul, I'm handing this to you at 2551234860 for overnight. I'm marking incident as in-monitoring. Please escalate to eng-runtime if TTL rollback needed. :white_check_mark:

sre_paul: Got it, taking over. Notes saved to PD incident. Will update if anything changes. :pray:

incident-bot: PD-89234 state changed -> monitoring. Incident duration so far: ~10m. Auto-close window: 6h unless new alerts fire.
